videos.title: Finding a booking
videos.intro: Every booking on the file is in one list, whatever its state. In this video you will find a booking, and open it.

scenes.say: Open All bookings, under Bookings in the menu. It shows every booking on the file, with the business date at the top.
Type in the search box: part of the guest's name, the reference, a room number, or a few digits of the phone.
Or tap a tile to see one state. Due in is every confirmed booking still to arrive, on any date. Each tile shows its count.
The status says where each booking stands: due in, in house, due out, checked out, or waiting for the hotel.
Cancelled, void and no-show bookings are never deleted. They are kept here, under their own tile.
Click a row, and the booking opens in the stay panel. Its More options holds every change to a booking.
The Bookings menu also holds New booking and CRS bookings. Groups is found with Find a screen, Ctrl K.

videos.outro: The next videos take a booking from the first call to the guest's voucher.

videos.title: A booking on the phone: the guest and the dates
videos.intro: A guest calls to book a room. In this video you will fill in who is coming, and for which nights.

scenes.say: Open New booking. It is one page, and it opens on today's business date, for one night and one room.
Type the guest's name, or the company's. It is the only guest detail that must be filled in.
Type the phone number. It is needed for online check-in and for WhatsApp. Add the email if the guest gives one.
If the system knows that phone, a line asks: same person? Press Same person only if it really is them.
Ask the guest if they agree to WhatsApp, and switch it on if they do. Unticked, messages go by email if there is one.
Set the arrival and departure dates. The nights are counted under them. The night of departure is not charged.
Choose the booking source: how the booking reached the hotel. Nothing is chosen for you, and it cannot be filled in later.
On the right, The booking adds it all up as you type: the nights, the rooms, the room charges, the GST, and what is due.

videos.outro: Next: the room, and its price.

videos.title: The room and its price
videos.intro: The guest asks what it will cost. In this video you will choose the room, and read its price.

scenes.say: Choose the room type.
Choose the meal plan: room only, with breakfast, with one more meal, with all meals, or everything charged to the room.
Then set how many rooms, adults and children.
Leave the rate empty, and the price comes from the rate calendar. Type a number only for a rate agreed with the guest.
Tick Rate includes GST when the rate you typed already has the tax in it. It stays off unless you tick it.
Picking a room is optional. Assign later is fine. A room you pick is kept.
This says how many rooms of the type are free on every night of the stay. You may book more. You decide.
The price line shows the rate a night, the tax and its rate, and the nights. Read it to the guest.
If there is no price for the party, the line says so, and the total stays a dash. The system never guesses a price.

videos.outro: Next: the ID, the advance, and saving the booking.

videos.title: The advance, the details and Save booking
videos.intro: In this video you will finish the form: the ID, an advance, the folded details, and the three buttons.

scenes.say: For a booking still to come, only the nationality is asked, as a two-letter code. The document is taken at check-in.
If the guest pays an advance now, type the amount and how it was paid. It is held as the guest's credit until the nights are charged.
Four sections are folded. More about the guest holds the address, the offers tick, and woman travelling alone.
Booking details holds whether the booking is confirmed, or waiting for the hotel.
The expected check-in and check-out times, if the guest said.
The business source: the company or agent behind the booking, if there is one.
And the sales person.
A discount: up to ten percent by hand, or rupees off a night, each with a reason. More than that only through a named promotion.
Company is for a booking billed to a company. Notes is for a note on the booking.
Then tap Save booking. On a phone booking, it is the one filled button.
A button that cannot be used yet says why, under the buttons. Here, Save and assign room waits for a room, and Check in now is only for an arrival today.

videos.outro: Next: what to do once it is booked.

videos.title: Booked: the reference and the voucher
videos.intro: The booking is saved. In this video you will see what the desk does next, in the order you do it on the phone.

scenes.say: The page says Booked, with the booking's reference. Read it to the guest.
The guest's page link shows a link to the guest's own page, to copy.
Send voucher sends the booking's one voucher. It goes once. After that, the page says when it went, and who sent it.
Here the sending buttons are grey, and say why: on this demo hotel, sending is not set up. A button that cannot work always says why.
View voucher opens the same voucher to look at, print or save. It sends nothing.
Send check-in link sends the voucher again, with the guest's check-in link.
Open the booking opens it in All bookings. Another booking clears the page for the next call.

videos.outro: If a step after the save is refused, the booking still stands, and this page says which step, and why.

videos.title: A walk-in, checked in at once
videos.intro: A guest at the desk, with no booking. In this video you will book them and check them in, on one page.

scenes.say: Start from the room, not from the menu. Open Rooms.
Tap a free room. New booking opens on that room, for tonight, one night.
The booking source is already Walk-in.
The room is the one you tapped, with its state. This one is clean.
Type the guest's name and phone, and check the price: one night, with its tax.
For an arrival today, the ID is asked here. Choose the document.
And type its number. Check in now records them.
On a walk-in, the one filled button is Check in now. Tap it.
Save booking would book the room without checking the guest in.
The page says Checked in.
And the guest is in house, in room 301.

videos.outro: Check in now uses the same checks as Arrivals. If it refuses, the booking still stands, and you check the guest in from Arrivals.

videos.title: A group of rooms
videos.intro: A wedding, or a family: one guest, one set of dates, several rooms. In this video you will book a group, and open its page.

scenes.say: On New booking, set the number of rooms. More than one room becomes a group by itself.
Give the group a name. Left empty, it is named after the guest.
The booking on the right says the rooms are booked as one group. Save it.
Each room gets its own reference.
Open the booking opens the group's page.
Every group is listed on Groups. Here and coming shows the groups in the house or due. All adds the past ones.
Tap a group to see its rooms, with its room-nights and its dates.
Two figures are kept apart: what the rooms owe, and what the host owes. A dash means there is no host account.
Open the group for its page.
With no host account, every room settles its own bill. Open a host account when the host pays.
The guests shows what the rooms owe on their own bills.
Tick Host pays on a room to put its accommodation on the host's account. Nights already charged stay where they were posted.
The lead guest gets the group's one confirmation. It starts on the room booked first.

videos.outro: A group's rooms are given their room numbers later, from Arrivals or the Calendar.

videos.title: Waiting for the hotel
videos.intro: Sometimes the hotel must accept a booking first. In this video you will hold a booking, and confirm it.

scenes.say: In Booking details, choose Waiting for the hotel. The room is held, and nothing goes to the guest.
After saving, the page says Held, waiting for the hotel.
No voucher and no link go to the guest until the booking is confirmed.
When the hotel accepts it, tap Confirm the booking.
Or do it later: open the booking, tap More options, then Confirm the booking.
The message says Confirmed: the voucher can go now. Every waiting room booked with it is confirmed together.
If the hotel does not accept it, choose Cancel this booking. It was never confirmed, so there is no charge, and nothing is sent.

videos.outro: Bookings sold by the CRS arrive the same way: waiting, with the room held, for the hotel to confirm.

videos.title: Changing dates, and moving rooms
videos.intro: Plans change. In this video you will change a booking's dates, and move a guest to another room.

scenes.say: Open the booking, and tap More options. The choices are listed by when they happen.
Change dates or guests changes the arrival, the departure, the adults and the children.
Move to another room is grey until the guest has arrived, and it says why. Before arrival, change the room on the Calendar.
What this booking includes lists its extras.
Here is Change dates or guests. The arrival stays as it is.
The departure moves one day later.
The line below says the change in words: two nights become three, with the room charges at the rate agreed.
Tap Save. If the room is taken on a night being added, nothing changes at all, and you are told.
The message says the stay was amended: two nights become three.
For a guest in the house, choose Move to another room. Type the new room.
Choose from which night. It starts on the business date.
Choose why they moved: they asked, an upgrade, a downgrade, or something wrong with the room.
Type a new rate only if the price changes. Left empty, nothing about the money changes.
Then tap Move. The nights before stay with the old room.

videos.outro: Exchange with another guest swaps the rooms of two guests who are both in the house.

videos.title: Cancel, void and no-show
videos.intro: Three ways a booking does not happen: cancelled, void, and no-show. None of them deletes the booking.

scenes.say: If the guest cancelled, open the booking, tap More options, then Cancel this booking.
The window first says what the booking's cancellation terms charge. This booking carries no terms, so nothing is charged.
Type why the guest cancelled. It must be filled in.
Keep it closes the window, and changes nothing.
Cancel the booking cancels this room only.
The message says the room is free again, and what was charged. Here, no charge.
The booking is not deleted. It is under Cancelled, void and no-show.
Here it is, marked Cancelled.
Void this booking is for one that should never have existed: entered twice, or the wrong property. A voided booking is left out of revenue, and out of cancellation figures.
A confirmed guest who never comes is marked a no-show by the night audit. The booking's terms decide what is kept.

videos.outro: Cancel and void are only for a booking that has not arrived. A guest in the house is checked out instead. That is bookings. Thank you for watching.
